_description: Global project registry. Tracks all of Brooke's active projects so they don't get lost. Updated by Claude or manually.

brookelib.description: Shared Python library — symlink registry of reusable modules
brookelib.notes: Ongoing — updated when new projects need shared modules

backup-tools.description: Manual backup scripts — NAS mount, rsync sync, scaffolding
backup-tools.notes: In use. Sub-project within brookelib repo.

build-system.description: Document build system — manifest-based markdown to PDF/DOCX

herd-essays.description: Essay RAG CLI — conversational REPL over essay projects with semantic retrieval

home-auto.description: Home automation framework — service registry, status engine, web dashboard

mob-shares.notes: Has own install.sh pattern — wrapper in ~/bin/mob

diigo-tagger.description: Diigo bookmark tagging with LLMs — auto-tagging, FTS5 search, HTMX web UI

catalyst-essays.description: AI essay writing platform — FastAPI backend, Astro frontend, MongoDB
catalyst-essays.notes: Mostly replaced by cattle and herd-essays

catalyst-continuum.description: AI story writing engine — entity recognition, continuity checking
catalyst-continuum.notes: Concept/docs stage only. Mostly replaced by cattle and herd-essays.

files-organizer.notes: Decoupled agent architecture planned — triage agent + specialised agents per semantic file type. Fully decoupled.

linux-env.notes: Deployed to /opt/linux-env/HOME, symlinked to ~. Ongoing maintenance.

bank-statements.description: Bank/credit card statement analysis — CSV parsing, fuzzy categorisation

amnesia-playback.description: Media playback wrapper — ffplay-based video/image display utilities

amnesia-content.description: Media file processing — rating-based selection, AES-256 encryption, manifest generation
